questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Be prepared to stop if the light is flashing.
There is a traffic signal ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a traffic signal ahead.
questions.explanation: A yellow sign with a traffic signal means a traffic signal is coming up. Get ready to respond to it.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs alert you to conditions ahead. This sign warns that another road crosses the highway.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The railroad crossing is controlled. Continue at your regular speed.
Look, listen, and prepare to stop at the crossing if necessary.
Stop at the railroad tracks and wait for a signal before crossing.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look, listen, and prepare to stop at the crossing if necessary.
questions.explanation: At a railroad crossing, look and listen for trains. Slow down and be ready to stop. Wait for any trains to pass before proceeding.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a stop sign is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: No turns are allowed on the road.
There is a series of curves ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a series of curves ahead.
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs alert you to conditions ahead. This sign warns of curves coming up on the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs alert drivers to areas where people like cyclists are likely to cross the road. Stay alert.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You should slow down and move to the right lane.
Stay in the right lane if you are driving more slowly than other traffic.
Slower traffic must exit on the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stay in the right lane if you are driving more slowly than other traffic.
questions.explanation: White rectangular signs show rules you must follow. This sign means slower drivers should use the right lane. This keeps the left lane open for passing and faster traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Diamond-shaped yellow signs warn of danger ahead. Orange diamond signs warn of dangers in or near construction areas.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead has many curves.
There is a sharp curve in the road ahead.
The road ahead may be slippery.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead may be slippery.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road may be slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a yield sign is coming up. Start slowing down when you see this warning.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed. You will often see it at intersections with heavy oncoming traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and yield to traffic on the main road when merging.
Always come to a complete stop.
Activate your turn signal and proceed into traffic at the usual speed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and yield to traffic on the main road when merging.
questions.explanation: A three-sided yield sign tells you to slow down at an intersection and let traffic from other roads pass first. You don't need to stop if no traffic is coming, but always slow down and enter carefully.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a divided highway is coming ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you of a reverse curve where the road curves right, then left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings and alert drivers to possible hazards. This sign warns of a steep hill ahead. Reduce your speed to avoid accidents and brake damage.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The vehicle is being drawn by an animal.
The vehicle is traveling at speeds of 25 mph or slower.

questions.correctAnswerText: The vehicle is traveling at speeds of 25 mph or slower.
questions.explanation: Slow-moving vehicles like bicycles, horse-drawn wagons, or farm equipment display this emblem to warn other drivers. It means the vehicle travels at 25 mph or slower.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A round yellow sign warns that a railroad crossing is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers that the divided roadway is ending and two-way traffic is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A five-sided yellow or yellow-green sign alerts drivers to a school zone or school crossing ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: May turn left only on a green arrow.
May turn left on a green light when it is safe.
Must wait for the solid green light before you turn left.

questions.correctAnswerText: May turn left on a green light when it is safe.
questions.explanation: "Yield" means slow down and be ready to stop to let other vehicles, cyclists, or pedestrians pass. After yielding, you may follow the other directions on the sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn. You cannot turn your vehicle around to go in the opposite direction at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Are approaching a railroad crossing and should prepare to stop.
Will always stop at the upcoming railroad crossing.
Should stop and wait for a signal before crossing the railroad tracks.

questions.correctAnswerText: Are approaching a railroad crossing and should prepare to stop.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a railroad crossing is ahead. Slow down, look, listen, and be ready to stop. Wait for any trains to pass before crossing.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Change in direction or narrowing of roadway.

questions.correctAnswerText: Change in direction or narrowing of roadway.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road is about to curve or become narrower. You may see these signs on sharp curves or approaching narrow bridges.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Mileage information, such as distances to specific locations.

questions.explanation: Blue signs tell you about motorist services available nearby. These include rest areas, food, gas stations, and hospitals.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign alerts you that an intersection is coming up so you can prepare to stop or turn.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Until after you pass the sign.
Unless it seems safe to do so.

questions.explanation: White rectangular signs show rules you must follow. This sign means do not pass other vehicles under any circumstances.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs alert you to upcoming conditions. This sign warns that you are leaving a divided highway and entering a road where traffic flows both directions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Are traveling in the wrong direction.
Must treat the intersection as if it is controlled by a stop sign.
May not proceed until it changes to green.

questions.correctAnswerText: Must treat the intersection as if it is controlled by a stop sign.
questions.explanation: A flashing red light means stop. Come to a complete stop, look both ways, and yield to all traffic and pedestrians before proceeding.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are not allowed to travel in this direction.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are not allowed to travel in this direction.
questions.explanation: Red signs mean an action is prohibited. If you see this sign, you are going the wrong way. Turn around immediately.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: An orange triangle on the back of a vehicle means it moves slowly. You may see this on farm equipment, roadwork vehicles, or horse-drawn wagons. During the day it appears orange. At night it reflects red.
